help.top:
Usage: dohc <command> <verb> [arguments] [options]

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.

Commands:
  document     Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents, and comment on
               tracked text files.
               read, edit, create, comment
  chat         Read and post in Groups and threads.
               groups, threads, inbox, show, post, reply, react, grep, export
  dataset      Create, change, and use transactional Collections.
               list, describe, history, historyRevision, prepareHistoryRestore,
               permissions, setGrant, removeGrant, lifecycle, archive, restore,
               deletePreview, delete, pendingAttempts, reconcileAttempt,
               cancelAttempt, export, prepareRecovery, claimRecovery,
               discardRecovery, upload, file, createForm,
               prepareRelationChoices, create, prepare, approve, discard,
               prepareMigration, migrationPreviewPage, prepareSchemaChange,
               approveMigration, discardMigration, invoke
  app          Approve, open, and share apps.
               createLink, listLocal, prepareLocal, launchLocal, list, prepare,
               approve, cancel, withdraw, revokeCollection, reviewReactivation,
               responses, undo-responses
  history      Read the changes History records for files.
               list, show
  automation   Press Button fields, read an automation's runs, and try a failed
               run again.
               list, switch, buttons, runs, run, retry, press

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc <command> --help to see what each verb does.
help.document:
Usage: dohc document <verb> [arguments] [options]

Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents, and comment on tracked text files.

Verbs:
  read      Read the current Markdown, including edits in an open editor.
  edit      Replace matching text or append Markdown through the live document.
  create    Create a Markdown document without overwriting an existing file.
  comment   Start a chat linked to a file with its first message.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Paths resolve from your current folder. Changes are recorded as an agent's, as
with MCP.
A refusal exits with status 1 and prints its reason to stderr, including with
--json.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc document <verb> --help to see its arguments and options.
help.document comment:
Usage: dohc document comment <path> [-] [options]

Start a chat linked to a file with its first message.

Use - as the body to read it from stdin.
The first message allows at most 64 KiB of UTF-8.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Paths resolve from your current folder. Changes are recorded as an agent's, as
with MCP.
A refusal exits with status 1 and prints its reason to stderr, including with
--json.

Options:
  --title <title>      Set the chat title. Use 1 to 200 characters that are not
                       all whitespace.
  --text <markdown>    Set the first message as Markdown. The message must
                       contain text that is not all whitespace.
  --agent <name>       Record this agent name with the change.
  --request-id <key>   Set a key for safe retries. Use 1 to 64 printable ASCII
                       characters. A retry with the same key and the same
                       payload returns the existing result. A retry with the
                       same key and a changed payload is refused.
  --run-id <id>        Set the run ID. The value must not be empty. This flag
                       overrides DOHC_RUN_ID.
  --as-agent           Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json               Print the result as JSON.
  --help               Show help. -h does the same.
